Hey everyone,

[*] Can now get ribs from cooking wolf meat.

Best,
Kcfos

notes.title: Garden of Mooj - Full Release
notes.notes:
[i]Hey everyone,
I'm very excited to share the full release build of Garden of Mooj. It's been over 2 years of development in early access and the game is ready for full release. There's also a new trailer![/i]

[list]
[b]New Content[/b]

[*] Payson will now give you their keystone to the final battle the day after completing their boat quest.
[*] Added the Alpha and Omega mooj aspects. To evolve into them, mooj need either 200+ Light or 200+ dark, respectively.
[*] The Alpha mooj will attack all enemies in range simultaneously.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/e37422eb271cd904de689974e40bb0a30a75df3b.png[/img]

[*] The Omega mooj will heal itself %25 of damage dealt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/6f2ee05789c11b3cdfc54c039b12689b7dbf5966.png[/img]

[*] Collecting all three keystones will unlock the final battle and ultimately the ending to the game. Be warned, the fight is harder than anything seen before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/610beb82f0ee400bbffd32dd84952afb2c7660d8.png[/img]

[*] After completing the battle you can choose to refight the final boss by talking to Rosie again.
[*] Added 4 new achievements

[b]Changes[/b]

[*] Updated mooj pattern generation. Mooj will now no longer have a seam in their pattern on one side. Mooj should also generate more varied patterns.
[*] Garden plants now have their own coloring for each plant
[*] Rare enemies will now begin spawning on night 3 and beyond, further unlocks beginning on night 6 and 9 for each garden. Before they unlocked after nights 5,10,15
[*] Can now recall mooj even when the altar is occupied.
[*] Added crawfish, catfish, butternut squash, and amanita mushrooms. All of which spawn in the twilight cavern.
[*] Heavily increased the amount of food that spawns in the cavern each day. 
[*] Added the elephant hat, it can be found in a secret area.
[*] Added localization for Chinese, Spanish, and Russian. These aren’t full translations, item names and descriptions aren’t translated, but dialogue, important UI, and everything needed to complete the game is translated.
[*] Increased the distance needed to stop a mooj from eating, as well as the proximity required to enter the eating state. This makes it less likely for mooj to get stuck eating.
[*] Payson now has their own speech sound
[*] Mooj will need to be slightly more hungry (from 140/200 to 175/200) for them to enter the grumpy state. 
[*] Mooj relics have been reworked. Instead of requiring a percentage proximity to specific colors, they require mooj to have above a required level of stats (Strength, Intelligence, Agility, Light, Dark).

[b]Bugs and Other[/b]

[*] Fixed a bug where mooj wouldn’t be saved correctly when recalled from outside the garden
[*] Fixed a bug where mooj would not save while evolving and being milked.
[*] Fixed a bug where the race countdown sound wasn’t being affected by the volume setting
[*] Fixed an issue where unpausing the game in the toll booth panel wouldn’t close the toll panel
[*] Cloning Lab will now properly clone mooj aspects
[*] Failing to defeat all wolves in Rosie’s wolf attack quest before the end of the night will now stop the quest from progressing, and you will need to try again.
[*] Lola’s final ritual quest will now proceed normally even if you’re in sandbox mode.
[*] Moved the sandbox mode toggle into the options menu.
[*] Mooj will now spend less time sleeping. They will also spend more time awake between rests
[*] Lowered the cost to unlock the Lost Lagoon from 200 to 100.
[*] Driftwood now have pickup sounds
[*] Increased Mooj info UI size
[*] Apple pies and cherry pies are now more valuable, to reflect the requirement of a cooking pot to make them
[*] Banana bread is more valuable

[/list]
[i]Please post any bugs / suggestions in the comments or forums.

Best,
Kcfos[/i]

notes.title: Release Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Garden of Mooj has some cool stuff being worked on, and will hopefully be able leave Early Access 'soon'. I know there hasn't been an update in a while, it's possible that there won't be another until the full release is ready. Thank you for being patient for all this time.

Here's the current roadmap on what's planned to be added to the 1.0 version of the game.

[list]
[*] Final quest chapter
This is what has been being worked on for the past 2 months, and I find it pretty fun. Definitely the most challenging section of the game.
[*] 2 advanced mooj aspect evolutions
These will be unlocked by meeting certain rare stat conditions.
[*] localization
[*] UI polish pass
[*] Unlock relic rework
Instead of giving a vague percentage breakdown of required stats, unlock relics will show a mooj stat chart, and the unlocking mooj will need to have equal to or higher for every stat shown.
[*] Additional Achievements
[/list]

These updates are all considered must-haves for full release.

There are other things I would also like to add, such as additional enemies, and maybe another building. I am considering waiting to add these less-important additions until after the full release.

If there's other things that you would like too see in the full release feel free to make suggestions. 

Best,
Kcfos

notes.title: March Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This update completes Lola's main quest line and also some other things. Lola doesn't have as many quests as Rosie, but their friendship mechanic means you'll still need to spend at least a couple days in the cavern to finish the quest. Recalling mooj from other gardens feels very useful, as previously the only way to move them was to bring them through the portals by hand, one-by-one.

[i] - Can now instantly recall mooj from other gardens in the mooj-recaller. This makes moving your mooj across gardens much less tedious

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/cadcf391a842a078af6c36f84dd469c62de763e9.png[/img]

 - Lola has a new quest. To complete it you must survive an extended night time onslaught, where you will encounter a new enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/5f6fbe0503241b1ef33cdea96796b2583491281b.png[/img]

 - Lola now has a friendship mechanic. You gain friendship by gifting items to them in their basket. Only certain items will be accepted, all of which are obtained within the cavern.
 In order to begin their final quest your friendship must be at 9 or above.

 - Added golems to the caverns. They begin appearing in the caverns at night after starting Lola's new quest. They summon explosive rocks and will drop a new food item: rock muffins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/5d82d606b690727f89387f4c5d1c888a4a09c1ee.png[/img]

 - After competing the new quest, the cavern shop will be upgraded to include 7 new egg colors:
[list]
[*] White
[*] Black
[*] Rose
[*] Purple
[*] Baby Blue
[*] Grey
[*] Aquamarine
[/list]

 - Lola now has a bunch of random chit-chat dialogues that they cycle through each day, like Rosie.

 - Removed the ability to sell items at the mooj statue altar. Now only the chest by shops will allow you to sell items

 - The mooj naming panel will now always have the correct rotation when picking newly hatched mooj up
 - Mooj eggs now have a more fitting icon
 - Evolution particles will no longer render over item sprites
 - Fixed a bug where recalling a sleeping mooj would cause the sleeping particles to remain on while they’re awake
 - Fixed some icons in dialogue text that weren’t aligned with the text properly
 - Fixed a bug where leaving the meadow during the campfire event would prevent enemies from spawning in other gardens
 - Fixed some animations that are unstable over long periods of time (naming panel text / mooj), (main menu title animations)

 - Fixed a bug where Lola’s quest status might have been overriding Rosie’s. This might have the consequence of reverting Lola’s first quest back to incomplete if it was completed on a previous version. Sorry for anyone that’s affected by this.

[/i]

We are approaching the 2 year anniversary of the game's early access release, which is also the soft deadline of my last release date estimate. I don't believe I am too far off from finishing the main story, but there are still elements that could use polish and care. My guess is an additional 2-3 months after the anniversary will be needed to transition from early access. There are still bugs that occur, and this time will help with that.

Leave any bugs/suggestions in the comments or email at kcfosf@gmail.com

Best,
Kcfos

notes.title: Aspect Evolution Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This update brings about the most powerful and diverse mooj evolution yet: Animal aspects. Once you've evolved your Mooj through the first 3 evolutions and fed them a large amount of food, they will reach their 4th and final evolution. This update also brings with it some minor balance changes and bug fixes. 

Added the fourth Mooj Evolution: Animal aspects. This final evolution will grant your mooj powerful abilities, as well as matching animal features. There are 6 total aspects to discover:

[b]Ram[/b]: The ram aspect's attacks will knock back enemies based on strength. Is also immune to fall damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/fa680f66b814f5eab959bec6395815aec1785f8a.png[/img]
[b]Pig[/b]: The pig aspect's powerful sense of smell can sense enemies from farther away, and also allows them to sense and dig up rare truffles. These can be sold for a high price, if your mooj doesn't eat them first.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/176e71f3a01a00f3862161c1eab73f7ce74776d5.png[/img]
[b]Demon[/b]: The demon aspect has increased attack speed based on percentage missing health. This ability is active if the mooj has lost more than a third of its' max hp
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/d28fca03b06f7324cef72ccdf38a84bf79629d5e.png[/img]
[b]Unicorn[/b]: The unicorn aspect has increased attack speed while it's being petted
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/daa79445438aaabe879f9631d1d97845294f4551.png[/img]
[b]Spore[/b]: The spore aspect attacks slower, but its attacks explode to damage all nearby enemies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/d91802d160629b43dfa3f4cff31060d2a6abc516.png[/img]
[b]Cat[/b]: The cat aspect pounces into melee range, dealing increased damage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/44cfa1a781b55ca78e76c1c0704ccb290dfbd011.png[/img]

If you want to know how to get a certain evolution here's how it works: Your Moojs' halo determines which of two aspects it can get. Depending on if the Moojs' light or dark stat is greater determines which of the two it gets.

Cube Halo: 
Dark: Ram
Light: Pig

Angelic Halo:
Dark: Demon
Light: Unicorn

Pyramid Halo:
Dark: Spore
Light: Cat

[b]Other Changes[/b]:
Mooj will now reach their first evolution faster
You now earn 100 gold for completing the tutorial
Increased the base health of red gremlins from 50 -> 80
The pyramid halo is now properly pyramid shaped, instead of wedge shaped
Changed the way halos in the second Mooj evolution are chosen. They're now based on the primary stat that has gained the most points since the last evolution. If Intelligence is highest the Mooj gets the 'angelic' halo. Agility gets the cube halo, and Strength gets the pyramid.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]:
Fixed a bug where throwing a mooj into water would cause them to stay in their thrown state forever and not move until picked up
Fixed a bug where newly evolved halos were not scaled properly
Fixed a bug where closing the game and reloading would reset garden plant growth progress
Fixed a bug where mooj would spawn with the wrong wings in race mode
Fixed a bug where saving/loading the game twice with an empty spot in the food shop would cause an apple pie to spawn in the spot


Now that Mooj have some powerful new abilities, it's time to up the ante. The next update should provide some difficult challenges to overcome...

Please report any bugs in the forms / comments, as well as make any suggestions.

Best,
Kcfos

notes.title: One Year of Early Access
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,	

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/e61cdc1509d5e3631c162238a7085e314aaecfd8.png[/img]
It's been one year since Garden Of Mooj was released early access. To celebrate the occasion I'd like to highlight some features added and discuss what's to come. This isn't an update patch, that will be coming later this week.

Since the game was first released many things have been added. On release there was only 1 complete garden, a handful of enemies, and your mooj. Since then the twilight cavern and the lost lagoon have 
both been added, as well as many enemies, hats, food, buildings, and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/719c6541e8a90f509153db2277c207e964069b0a.png[/img]

	Over the next 6 months the following features will hopefully be added to the game. None of these are set in stone and are subject to change:
	
	[list]
[*]A fourth Mooj evolution, granting powerful combat abilities
[*]More challenging content suited for the highest evolution of mooj
	[*]Two more NPCs with quest lines, one for the lagoon and one for the cavern
	[*]One more garden, which will unlock when all 3 questlines are completed
	[*]One more race
[*]Expanded encyclopedia, with stat information on enemies
[*]At least two more buildings
[*] A rework of the unlock relics so that they show exact stat requirements 
[*]And more?
[/list]

	Once these are done there will be a long period of polishing, making sure that the game is perfect. All in all, the game will hopefully be fully released before this time next year. Thank you for being patient so far. Let me know your thoughts on the proposed features and your suggestions.

Best,
Kcfos

With over 60 food items in the game, there were too many possible combinations for the ~10 product foods. So for now it’s been made easier. [*]Lowered spawn rate of enemies
[*]Rebalanced gold per kill, damage, and enemy health
[*]Healthbars now have outlines and show max health in black 
[*]Mooj can now be attacked while being held
[*]Mooj can now be damaged like enemies, currently all mooj have 200 health.
[*]Mooj will faint upon reaching 0 health, rendering them unable to defend while they recuperate
[*]While fainted, mooj will slowly regen health, waking up on reaching %50
[*]Mooj will fully heal with the start of a night


[*]Added wolves, an enemy that keeps its distance, but is very dangerous
[*]Seeds drop less often in favor of food drops
[*]The river in creepy caverns is now deeper
[*]Items in the shop will display the price their sold at above them
[*]Seeds now have color spheres again
[*]Acorns now have outlines again
[*]Updated the splash Screen
[*]Mooj Wings are now colored with a mooj’s primary and secondary colors accordingly
[*]Mooj eyes, mouth now use higher quality textures
[*]Small UI changes


[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[*]Mooj Eggs now have names / descriptions
[*]Fixed a bug where if a player picked up a hat before a mooj put it on the info panel would [*]stay on screen
[*]Fixed a bug where mooj would sometimes evolve past 3, changing nothing
[*]Fixed a bug where Timers from the cooking pot and milking machine would remain when moving into a different garden
[*]Timers will now not render when the game is paused
[*]Mooj will no longer be able to put on multiple hats at once
[*]Universally lowered all music volume by %50. Seemed loud at default values.
[*]The sparks floating in the main menu will no longer render in front of buttons
[*]The relic unlocking the caverns no longer shows an %80 proximity requirement for secondary color, as any color works.
[*]Item sprites will now correctly render in order of how close they are to the camera
[*]This also applies to text (damage numbers, healthbar numbers). Milking/Cooking timers still have this issue

[/list]

Feel free to suggest any changes in the forms or comments.
Best,
Kcfos

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991032/82bf56b2c31a475ff0b367b676e659a8845a7640.gif[/img]

notes.title: July Update - Released
notes.notes:
- Time of day is now saved between gardens and through saving and loading. Saving at night and reloading will start you 10 seconds before night time.

Sandbox mode can be enabled before loading a game
	- Enemies won't spawn at night
	- Day count won't go up at the dawn of a new day
	- Everything else is the same, you'll still be able to forage for food, grow crops, etc

- Added in the Mooj Pen. Keeps Mooj in and out. Things can only be moved through the barrier when held by the player. Can be unlocked in the Cavern garden
- Pause menu can no longer be opened in the main menu
- Shrank the size of messages
- Number of enemy spawns now scale with days passed in the particular garden
- Stronger enemy variants will now spawn at later days
- Mooj will sometimes do neat tricks like backflips and spins
- Mooj will no longer eat forage spawned food before it's been picked up. They'll still eat food spawned by enemies
- Mooj stats fit the chart better when maxed
- Can now move food and seed items between Gardens by holding them while entering
- Seeds will now be saved and loaded
- Mooj will always load in with black outlines
- Daytime now lasts 5 minutes from 4.
- Fixed an issue where items in the shop would not save properly
- Certain buildings should no longer spawn slightly above ground

[b]Creepy Caverns[/b]

- Mooj are now brighter/easier to see in Creepy Caverns
- Added more vegetation and detail
- There’s now a sacrificial altar on top of the hill in Creepy Caverns. You can  sacrifice any unwanted Mooj for a couple gold coins.
- Added new foods to Cavern (Crabs, lemons)
- Added two new music tracks
- Some foods the used to spawn in the Meadow now spawn in the Cavern instead (Oyster, red pepper)
- Treants are slower but now have an armor stat that flatly reduces damage taken. Green Treants have 5 armor, other variants have more. This makes it so Mooj that have high agility but low strength won’t be as strong in the Caverns.
- Updated Pumpkin sprite
- Unlocking Creepy Caverns now requires a level 2 Mooj, and unlocking the cannon requires a level 3

Let me know what you guys think of the update. I'll probably do a few rounds of fixes/polish before starting next months update.
